definitions.explanation: A book in which someone, usually a public figure, looks back on their life and the events they took part in.

examples.japanese: {元首相|もとしゅしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{回顧録|かいころく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The former prime minister published his memoirs.

examples.japanese: {回顧録|かいころく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏話|うらばなし}→裏話：14031_urabanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The memoirs tell the inside story of those days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{外交官|がいこうかん}→外交官：14758_gaikoukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{回顧録|かいころく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舞台裏|ぶたいうら}→舞台裏：08377_butaiura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧だ。
examples.english: The retired diplomat's memoirs are a valuable source on what went on behind the scenes of the negotiations.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {回顧録|かいころく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to publish one's memoirs
- {回顧録|かいころく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ / ⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}する→執筆する：25397_shippitsusuru⟧: to write one's memoirs
- ⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{回顧録|かいころく}: a politician's memoirs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自伝|じでん}→自伝：25302_jiden⟧: autobiography — the story of one's whole life; a {回顧録|かいころく} centers on the events one witnessed
- {回想録|かいそうろく}: memoirs — nearly the same, a little more personal in tone
